title: LeagueApps Protects $54M in Revenue for Youth Sports Organizations - Vertical Insure
markdown:
October 21, 2026

LeagueApps Protects $54M in Revenue for Youth Sports Organizations

LeagueApps, the youth sports league management software, partnered with Vertical Insure to embed in-platform Refund Protection and Accident & Injury Coverage, supporting families and leagues making a difference in their communities.

![](https://verticalinsure.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/FY26Q4_LeagueApps-Case-Study-Social-Post_1200x628.jpg)

“Youth sports organizations are the backbone of their communities, and LeagueApps is committed to giving them the tools they need to offer players and parents the best experience possible. Thanks to our partnership with Vertical Insure we can provide families peace of mind when registering their kids for sports programs, while also helping clubs reduce refund requests and the administrative burden that comes with those. Organizations therefore spend less time on paperwork and more time delivering amazing sports experiences. It’s a critical part of our commitment to help organizations thrive, and that’s an all around win.”

Brian Litvack

CEO,LeagueApps

NaN

### of at-risk revenue protected

Successful youth sports clubs, leagues and tournaments don’t just happen: they require a dedicated group of admins, coaches, officials, and families to create an impact. They take a village; literally. [LeagueApps](https://leagueapps.com/) was founded on the belief that youth sports can make communities better. It does this by providing youth sports practitioners with the solutions they need to make it all happen. From registration and payments, to scheduling and communications, LeagueApps helps clubs run smoothly and efficiently, empowering them to create amazing experiences for athletes and their families.

When it comes to business innovation, LeagueApps takes a thoughtful approach, carefully considering the ways in which new features can support both clubs and end users. From lacrosse to hockey to soccer, LeagueApps has helped thousands of clubs grow and provide a better experience for more athletes. That’s where partnership with Vertical Insure comes in.

## The Challenge: Unexpected Dropouts Mean Refund Requests

Injuries, busy family schedules, unforeseen life events, and countless other variables make planning a youth sports season challenging. The most detailed plan for a season or tournament can’t prevent these interruptions. The problem is that interruptions cause dropouts, which means teams and leagues are faced with issuing refunds.

Although a Cancel for Any Reason policy seems like a helpful feature for families, this kind of policy causes more problems than it solves. When families can pull their athletes out at any time, leagues quickly lose the investment they need from athletes to make schedules run smoothly. LeagueApps needed to protect their customers against refund requests and secure commitment from families.

## The Solution: Protection for Refunds + Accident & Injury

LeagueApps partnered with Vertical Insure to embed [Refund Protection and Accident & Injury Coverage](https://verticalinsure.com/sports/) for organizations to offer their youth sports clients. Now, if a player is forced to withdraw due to unforeseen circumstances, Refund Protection reimburses up to 100% of their registration fees. Families get their money back for the part of the season they can’t participate in and sports organizations no longer have to scramble to offer those refunds.

Young athletes and their families have better experiences when they’re protected against the unknown. Every year, 12 million athletes between the ages of 5 and 22 experience sports injuries. Now that organizations using LeagueApps can offer Accident & Injury Protection inside the registration workflow, families can get financially protected from injuries that occur during games, tournaments, practice, and travel.

## The Result: $54M of Organizational Revenue Protected

LeagueApps saw that there was an opportunity to provide more value and serve the youth sports community with embedded protection. After a speedy, seamless implementation, the benefit was clear.

Since activation in January 2025, LeagueApps has offered protection for more than $54 million in revenue for its organizations that would have been at risk to refunds, credits, and bad debt. The platform’s high level of conversion, is a reflection of the value embedded protection provides for end users. Families with children in sports juggle hectic schedules and sometimes-fluctuating finances, and having access to embedded coverage means one less thing to worry about.
